summary_1line: Chyavana reveals he tested King Kusika with extreme trials intending to destroy his lineage but, impressed by the king’s patience and virtue, abandoned the plan.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged sage Chyavana sleeps unmoving for twenty-one days on a royal bed while King Kusika and his queen patiently keep watch beside him.
The sage sets heaps of sumptuous food ablaze in the palace hall while the king and queen stand silently, restraining their anger.
King Kusika and his queen harness themselves to a chariot and pull the ascetic Chyavana through the city streets.
